# P37.34 — Watch feeds v2

**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/458_P37.34__watch-feeds-v2.md` (row 458 · Round 11 / P37 sub-round 11D · R11-K13-WX-04b · size M · `live_verification=false` · gate `none` · not an OM-20 row)

**Requirements stamped (§56.11 owner rows):** **SIG-WATCH-005** (Feeds validate — iCal RFC 5545 incl. empty calendars, RSS 2.0 with `atom:link self`, JSON Feed 1.1; served `text/calendar` / `application/rss+xml` / `application/feed+json`; UIDs stable across builds on the production domain), **SIG-WATCH-006** (Real feed timestamps — `DTSTAMP`/`lastBuildDate` from the watch build, never a fixture constant).

Cited: SIG-WATCH-004 (a feed per place page, empty or not — D-K7-5), SIG-WATCH-002 (an `upper_bound` is never a deadline inside feed bytes), SIG-UI-036/041 (T0-class bytes; `/watch/**.ics|.xml|.json|feeds.opml` per the K13 route table), SIG-OPS-003/004 (feed paths stay the release web build's — the lane never owns them, P37.33 verbatim).

## What landed

- **`web/src/lib/watch-feeds.ts`** — the feed model + emitters: `feedScopes`/`scopeItems` (all, every emitted place page, the six kinds, the present vendor/technology facet values), `toWatchICal` (UID `<handle>@surveillancegraph.org`, `SEQUENCE` = 1 on the wire's `superseded` move signal else 0, `STATUS:CANCELLED` on withdrawn/superseded with no reason text, `DTSTART;VALUE=DATE`, `URL`, `REFRESH-INTERVAL;VALUE=DURATION:P1D` + `X-PUBLISHED-TTL:P1D`, UTC `VTIMEZONE` on empty), `toWatchRss` (`pubDate` = `first_seen`, `lastBuildDate` = build stamp, `<ttl>1440</ttl>`), `toWatchJsonFeed` (1.1 shape + `_sig` provenance block), `toWatchOpml` (outlines per place scope), `feedBuiltAt` (the payload's `generated_at` — SIG-WATCH-006).
- **Endpoints:** `watch/feeds/[...scope].ics.ts`, `[...scope].xml.ts`, `[...scope].json.ts` (per-scope static bytes) and `watch/feeds.opml.ts`; a per-item `.ics` at `watch/feeds/item/<handle>.ics` linked from the item page ("add to calendar"); place pages gain the subscribe trio; `/watch/feeds/` directory rewritten to list every emitted feed + OPML + the W-P5 no-email-list how-to + the legacy per-jurisdiction renewal feeds (still emitted, honestly named).
- **`ops/web/nginx.conf`** — `text/calendar ics` + `text/x-opml opml` at http level; `location /watch/feeds/` carries the feed `types` (`application/rss+xml xml`, `application/feed+json json`, `text/html html`, …) with `max-age=3600`; `location ~ ^/watch/[^/]+\.xml$` fixes the legacy jurisdiction feeds' `text/xml` defect (K7 Q11).
- **`web/scripts/check-feeds.mjs`** — feed validation wired into `npm run check`: every emitted feed parsed (iCal folding/CRLF/components/UID/DTSTAMP==build/SEQUENCE/STATUS/URL, RSS well-formedness + self-link + item fields, JSON Feed 1.1 shape, OPML outlines resolving to emitted files), every place page has its feed trio, the directory's hrefs resolve, feeds ≤ the T0 `documentMaxBytes` from `page-budgets.json`.
- **`web/src/lib/nav.ts`** — the "Feeds" child restored (staged for this row).
- **`docs/build/reports/copy-batches/batch-23.md`** — WF-01…04 drafted sentences, pending operator verbatim confirmation (`tests/unit/test_p37_34_copy_batch.py` binds them).
- **Tests:** `web/tests/unit/watch-feeds.test.ts` (14 — scope coverage, UID stability, SEQUENCE/STATUS, DTSTAMP≠fixture, empty VTIMEZONE, upper_bound-never-deadline, RSS rules, JSON Feed, OPML), `web/tests/e2e/watch-feeds.spec.ts` (9 — wire-level validation incl. in-browser XML parse, empty-place feed exists, item .ics, directory + page links), `tests/unit/test_p37_34_watch_feed_nginx.py` (3 — the serving-type contract).
- **CHANGELOG.md** — public-behaviour entry.
- **COVERAGE_MATRIX.csv** — SIG-WATCH-005 + SIG-WATCH-006 → `MET-ENGINEERED(D-R10-PUBLISH-1)` (sibling MET-row convention; owed leg rides `D-R10-PUBLISH-1`).

## Acceptance shape

- Capstone journey **O2** (K13 §8): dossier → `/watch/place/<path>/` → `.ics`; the feed validates and exists even with 0 items (the `/watch/feeds/place/deu.ics` VTIMEZONE case is e2e-asserted).
- Page-type budget **T0 (feeds)**: feed files carry no scripts; the validator binds the T0 `documentMaxBytes` ceiling; `/watch/feeds/` stays T1 (no new scripts; `t1-module-entries.json` untouched).

## Verification

- `npm --prefix web run typecheck` — clean (591 files, 0 errors).
- `npx vitest run tests/unit/watch-feeds.test.ts` — 14 green.
- `npm run build` — 485 pages; `node scripts/check-feeds.mjs` — **PASS, 141 feed files validated** (85 .ics, 27 .xml, 27 .json, 1 .opml, ≤153 600 B).
- `npx playwright test watch-feeds.spec.ts` — 9 green.
- `uv run pytest tests/unit/test_p37_34_copy_batch.py tests/unit/test_p37_34_watch_feed_nginx.py` — 8 green; `ruff check`/`format` clean.
- Not run locally: full `npm run check` tail legs + `make check` full suite (the head-bound CI run is the authoritative read — recorded as the `ci:` line); Docker legs not available in this environment.

## Notes

- The lane (P37.33) never owns feed paths — `lane_owns_object` excludes `watch/feeds/**` by shape (facets/feeds/citations/archive are the web build's); `ops/public_routes_watch.toml` unchanged, `ops/public_routes.toml` unchanged (`watch` already allow-listed+required).
- `SEQUENCE` rule: the `sig.watch-item/1` wire's only recorded move signal is `status: "superseded"` → `SEQUENCE:1` (documented in `watch-feeds.ts`); a two-build UID-identical + moved-date SEQUENCE+1 pair is unit-tested.
- Content-type assertions for `.xml`/`.json` live at the nginx contract (pytest + check-feeds + composed serving), not astro preview — preview serves static files by extension map.
